02 / The experience

A workspace with
a point of view.

Not another distro image. WavesOS brings together a coordinated set of desktop tools, visuals, and quality-of-life choices—then lets you decide how far to take it.

WavesOS / desktop environmentQuietly capable.

One visual language

Matugen ties color into the setup so your desktop feels like one place, not a pile of packages.

Designed around Hyprland

A dynamic Wayland compositor is the center of the experience, with Rofi and Waybar close at hand.

You stay in control

Start with the guided menu or choose the full install. The installer only asks for sudo when it needs it.

Open source by nature

Community maintained and inspectable. Explore the scripts before you run anything.

04 / Begin here

From shell
to shore.

From the directory containing your WavesHyprland folder, run the setup commands below.

Read the installer source
bash — wavesos setup⌘
$ cd WavesHyprland$ chmod +x install.sh scripts/*.sh
# Guided installer menu
$ ./install.sh
# Or select the complete setup
$ ./install.sh --all
✓ Sudo is requested only when needed
Review the README first. Run the installer as a normal user; it requests sudo only when needed.
